about.title: Quality management, traceability and compliance in one connected workspace
about.content: QualiTrack helps pharmaceutical laboratories digitize critical quality operations through laboratory profiles, equipment monitoring, batch traceability, compliance alerts, KPI dashboards, audit logs and subscription-based access.

panel.platform-description: A connected workspace for regulated pharmaceutical quality teams.

value.title: Built for daily quality operations
value.subtitle: QualiTrack connects operational records, equipment data and compliance evidence so quality teams can work with more control and less manual effort.

traceability.title: End-to-end traceability
traceability.description: Connect laboratories, products, raw materials and production batches to keep quality evidence organized.

monitoring.title: Equipment visibility
monitoring.description: Track equipment status, BPM parameters, telemetry measurements and maintenance records from one place.

audit.title: Audit-ready evidence
audit.description: Generate reports, inspect KPI dashboards and review audit logs for critical quality actions.

workflow.title: From registration to regulatory evidence
workflow.description: The platform follows the natural work of a laboratory quality team, from setup to monitoring, control and reporting.
items: Register the laboratory, staff, products and raw materials.
Configure equipment, BPM parameters and maintenance records.
Track batches, telemetry measurements, anomalies and compliance alerts.
Review KPIs, generate reports and keep audit evidence available.

team.title: A product designed around pharmaceutical quality workflows
team.description: QualiTrack was created to support laboratories that need better visibility, traceability and confidence when managing regulated production and quality processes.
